newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa sees 222.8 mln-real inflow in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa sees 222.8 mln-real inflow in Dec.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it registered net foreign capital inflows of 222.8 million reais in the first ten days of December.
Foreign buys amounted to 1.207 billion reais in the period versus foreign sells of 984.7 million reais, it said.
In November, the Bovespa saw net capital inflows of 312 million reais, it said.
So far this year, net foreign capital inflows have totalled 2.881 billion reais, the bolsa said.
